data.camara_frigate: Cámara de Frigate para las caras

data_description.timbre: El `binary_sensor` que se enciende al pulsar el timbre.
data_description.camara: Su imagen va en los avisos cuando no hay una foto mejor.
data_description.camara_frigate: Nombre de la cámara en Frigate. Vacío: no se usan caras.
data_description.umbral_cara: Una cara cuenta como conocida si su puntuación es mayor que esto.
data_description.vista_llamada: Parte de la ruta del panel de llamada. Entrar en él (sin `-ver`) cuenta como atender.
data_description.personas: Counts the people on that camera (`sensor.<camera>_person_count`). With it, a face only starts a visit if Frigate already counts a person, which avoids false detections.

data_description.al_empezar: Por ejemplo, el zoom de la cámara y silenciar el altavoz. Los de las tablets van en cada dispositivo del hogar.
data_description.comparar: Modo sombra: las que hacen hoy lo que hará la integración. Sus llamadas se comparan con las de la integración.

sin_app.title: {dispositivo}: Home Assistant app not found
sin_app.description: The selected device no longer has the Home Assistant app registered (for example, after a reinstall). Edit the device in the Videoportero integration and pick the new one.

sin_servicio_avisos.title: {dispositivo}: no notification service
sin_servicio_avisos.description: {detalle} does not exist: this phone gets no notifications. Check the Home Assistant app is installed and logged in.

sin_ultima_app.title: {dispositivo}: «Last used app» sensor missing
sin_ultima_app.description: Without it, opening the Home Assistant app during a visit is only detected through BrowserMod, later and not always. Enable it in the app: Settings → Companion app → Manage sensors → Last used app.

sin_browsermod.title: {dispositivo}: BrowserMod sensor not found
sin_browsermod.description: {detalle} does not exist or is disabled. Without it, opening the call view does not count as answering. Register the browser in BrowserMod again or edit the device.

sin_visibilidad.title: {dispositivo}: BrowserMod visibility missing
sin_visibilidad.description: {detalle} does not exist or is disabled. Without it, if Home Assistant was already the last used app, opening it does not count as answering. Enable it on the BrowserMod device.

sin_script.title: {dispositivo}: script {detalle} does not exist
sin_script.description: This home device will do nothing when a visit starts. Create the script or edit the device.
